title: 双院模型：并行语言模型间的双向隐状态耦合
summary: 提出双院模型，通过可训练神经接口耦合两个冻结的预训练语言模型的中间隐状态，实现连续、并发的协调。主模型驱动任务，辅助模型操作工具，通过翻译网络和抑制门学习选择性通信协议，无需预设格式。在算术、逻辑谜题和数学推理任务上显著提升性能。
summary_en: Proposes the Bicameral Model, coupling two frozen pretrained language models via a trainable neural interface on intermediate hidden states for continuous, concurrent coordination. A primary model drives the task while an auxiliary operates tools, learning a selective communication protocol from task loss alone. Achieves significant accuracy gains on arithmetic, logic puzzles, and math reasoning.
